newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-BECKENBAUER SEEKS LESSONS FROM PLATINI.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BECKENBAUER SEEKS LESSONS FROM PLATINI.

text.p: Franz Beckenbauer will fly to France with a German delegation on Friday for some lessons from former international Michel Platini on how Germany can win their campaign to host the 2006 World Cup.
Beckenbauer and German soccer federation (DFB) president Egidius Braun are keen to copy Platini's high-profile role when he helped France win the battle for the 1998 finals.
The Germans hope to give former World Cup-winning captain and coach Beckenbauer the same job in their campaign.
